FAQs

# Frequently Asked Questions

Last updated: 29th July 2026.

## Support with New Website

What about a booking I made in your old system?

**Online:** Your email booking confirmation won’t be valid. Please arrive at the Main Bar so we can confirm your booking before you enter.

**In person:** Bring your existing tickets to the Main Bar on arrival for entry. We can only manage this booking in person and if you have the existing tickets.

What about a gift card, e-Gift card or e-Gift Membership I purchased using your old system?

These still work as normal in person and on the website, within their usual validity.

Why have you made this change?

After more than four years of operation, we’re focused on delivering a rich cultural programme and a fantastic escapist experience. As with many businesses, we’re also managing costs and refining practices. There’ll be new features in future; for now we’re keeping it simple while still delivering great screenings and experiences.

How do I see What’s On and make a booking?

Filter *What’s On* by date, title or strand, then pick a time. Choose your seats and quantity, then select ticket/voucher types. On the final step you can redeem gift cards or pay by card.

How do I manage my Membership?

**Membership:** View benefits, check *Vouchers* (remaining free tickets), and access a digital card. See your subscription terms.

**Account Information:** Update personal and contact details.

**Order History:** See bookings made in the new system and what’s upcoming.

**Payment Information:** Store a debit/credit card or gift card. Adding a debit/credit card enables auto-renew at term end.

**My Movies:** Create a watchlist, favourite and rate films from our catalogue.

**Manage Marketing Preferences:** Opt in/out of our newsletter.

## General

How do I find out what’s on?

The cinema programme runs Friday–Thursday. Public booking typically opens the Tuesday beforehand; selected films, seasons and events are listed as early as possible.

Sign up for our weekly newsletter via the section at the bottom of our homepage.

What are your general opening times?

We open at least 15 minutes before the first film of the day.

Can I use the upstairs bar and terrace?

Absolutely — everyone is welcome to use all of our spaces. No Membership required.

Do you sell food and drink?

Our bars serve soft drinks, wines, beers, spirits, hot drinks and more. We also offer popcorn, nibbles, sweets and ice creams. Our kitchen partners Little Bao Boy serve food in the bars and in the screens at selected times.

Please don’t bring your own food or drink.

What are the opening times of the Lounge & Terrace?

Weekdays: 16:00–22:00  
Saturday & Sunday: 12:00–22:00

How do I find out what is on in the Lounge & Terrace?

We host regular events as part of our bar programme. See the Lounge & Terrace page for details. [LINK](#)

Are you currently hiring?

Available vacancies are listed via our online recruitment portal. [CLICK HERE](https://trafalgar.mystaffsavvy.com/apply/)

How do I contact customer service?

Email [[email protected]](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#ef86818980af8c87869c98868c848c86818a828ec18c80c19a84). We don’t have a public phone line; requests are handled in person or via email.

Do you show adverts and trailers?

Most general releases include approximately 20 minutes of adverts and trailers. Please arrive for the advertised start time; timings can change and latecomers may not be admitted.

How can I find you?

**By train** – Five minutes’ walk from Turnham Green and Stamford Brook Underground stations.

**By bus** – Served by the 110, 190, 237, 267, H91, N9, N11.

**By cycle** – Cycle parking is right outside the cinema.

Out of respect for our neighbours, please walk or use public transport if you can.

Is parking available near the cinema?

Chiswick Cinema ticket holders get discounted parking at The Hogarth Health Club (Airedale Ave, W4 2NW) during selected hours when presenting a valid cinema ticket.

**Hours**  
Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00  
Sat–Sun 12:00–21:00  
Note: the car park is closed outside these times.

- £4 standard hourly rate.
- £2 per hour for Chiswick Cinema customers with a same-day film ticket/booking confirmation (show to Hogarth Front of House).
- Press for a ticket at entry; pay at Hogarth Reception after your film (rate applies from your entry time).
- Card payments only. Hogarth Club car park use only.

Who can I talk to about supplying products?

As part of Trafalgar Entertainment, contracts and supply are handled centrally. Email FAO Head Office: [[email protected]](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#f990979f96b99a91908a8e909a929a90979c9498d79a96d78c92).

Who can I talk to about your programme?

For programme suggestions, email [[email protected]](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#2c45424a436c4f44455f5b454f474f454249414d024f43025947). For sales enquiries, contact the Picturehouses programme team.

## Tickets & Pricing

Pricing

**Off-Peak:** Weekdays before 5pm

- Adult: £14.00
- Senior (60+): £13.00
- Child (1–14): £10.00
- Family Ticket: £45.00

**Peak:** Weekdays after 5pm, all day weekends and bank holidays

- Adult: £18.50
- Senior (60+): £17.50
- Child (1–14): £14.00
- Family Ticket: £50.00

**Screen Arts & Special Events:**

- Adult: £22.00
- Child (1–14): £14.00

An online booking fee of £1.90 applies per online transaction.

3D films have an uplift per ticket; glasses are priced separately.

Prices may vary for selected screenings. Clubs & Groups pricing is listed separately.

What is a family ticket?

Available on 12A or under rated general release films. Valid for either 1 adult (15+) + 3 children (1–14) or 2 adults + 2 children. No further discounts or Membership benefits apply.

What does TBC mean?

*To be certified* — the film doesn’t yet have a BBFC certificate, so only adult tickets are available until a certificate is applied.

What is your refund policy? Can I swap my tickets?

Tickets can be refunded or swapped (different day/time) **in venue only** up to 24 hours before the screening start time.

We cannot offer refunds or swaps online/by phone/email or inside 24 hours. Bookings made with Member free tickets follow the same policy.

The booking fee is non-refundable.

Bring your booking details and payment card to the Main Bar no later than 24 hours before the start time and we’ll assist where possible.

What partner tickets or discount vouchers do you accept?

The following offers are accepted:

- BAFTA Members card – one free ticket Mon–Thu before 5pm, booked in person on the day.
- Film & TV Veterans card – one free ticket Mon–Thu before 5pm, booked in person on the day.
- Cinema Society vouchers – redeemable at selected times (check with the issuer).
- MUBI GO – accepted in person on the day of the screening. [Terms](https://mubi.com/en/mubi_go_terms_of_service)

## Accessibility

Is the venue wheelchair accessible?

All levels are served by a passenger lift with level access to each screen. Every screen has a wheelchair bay with a companion seat. These can be booked using a CEA Carer Card on our website or by emailing [[email protected]](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#751c1b131a35161d1c06021c161e161c1b1018145b161a5b001e).

Do you accept CEA Carer Cards?

Yes. The CEA Card entitles a companion to one free ticket. More info: [www.ceacard.co.uk](https://www.ceacard.co.uk).

How is your cinema laid out?

Take a full 3D tour of the building here: [LINK](#).

Do you offer audio-description or induction loop facilities?

Not at this time — we apologise for any inconvenience.

Do you have subtitled screenings?

Usually once a week (often Thursdays) we host a screening with English descriptive subtitles. These are standard screenings and open to everyone.

Do you welcome dogs?

Assistance dogs are welcome at general screenings. Dogs are welcome in our ground-floor café. We also occasionally run Dog Friendly screenings.

Can I bring my baby?

Babies under 1 may attend U/PG/12A films free of charge if seated on an adult’s lap. Children 1+ require a child ticket appropriate to the film’s certificate. If your child causes a disturbance, please step out of the auditorium — we’ll do everything we can to help make your visit stress-free.

Can I bring prams, luggage or large packages into the auditorium?

Please bring only items that fit safely beneath your seat. We’re unable to store luggage.

Prams/buggies can’t be kept in the auditorium (fire regulations). Ask a team member and we may be able to store them outside the screen for you.

Do you have Baby Changing facilities?

Yes — changing stations are in the ground-floor and second-floor WCs.

## Membership

Do I need to be a Member to visit the cinema?

No. Membership offers great discounts and benefits but isn’t required to visit. We recommend advance booking to avoid disappointment.

What are the benefits of Membership?

See our Membership sign-up page for full details — benefits include free/discounted tickets and food & drink discounts. [LINK](#)

I’d like to become a Member — how do I join?

Join online or speak to our team on your next visit. [LINK](#)

Do I get a Membership card?

We've introduced physical Membership cards designed by local artist Charlotte Berridge to compliment your Membership. The cards are made from recycled plastic and are supplied by Plastic Card People.

You can also sign in with your email/password to book, or give your details to our team at the venue. A digital Membership card is also available in the online sign-in area.

Can I buy Membership as a gift?

Yes — we offer **e-gift vouchers** redeemable against Memberships, delivered by email via our online Gift shop. [LINK](#)

How do I use my free Member tickets?

Select a film time and seat, then on the *Select Your Ticket* screen choose the *voucher* option to claim a free ticket. To see how many you have left, sign in and check *Vouchers*.

Can someone else use my Membership benefits?

Benefits are for the named account holder only. *Platinum Plus* is designed for regular pairs who want to share benefits.

How do I book for another Member?

Not currently possible in our system (improvements are planned).

How do I renew my Membership?

New memberships in the new system auto-renew at year end. Manage renewal in your online account — remove your card or set the subscription to end at the current term if you don’t wish to renew.

Can I use my Member free tickets on 3D screenings?

Platinum Members can use their unlimited free ticket on 3D screenings without the uplift.

Gold/Classic Members pay a small uplift in addition to any free ticket used.

## Gifts

What is an e-Gift Membership?

Email voucher redeemable against a Membership (level depends on purchase). Valid for one year from purchase; on redemption it activates a one-year Membership at the chosen level. Not sold in person; can be emailed to any address (including your own to pass on).

What is an e-Gift Card?

Digital voucher emailed to you or a recipient. Redeem online or in person for anything. Not sold in person. Valid for one year from purchase.

What is a Gift Card?

Physical gift cards available in venue. Redeem online or in person for anything. Not available to order online.

## Clubs & Groups

Do you do Group Bookings?

For public screenings, email [[email protected]](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#e68f888089a6858e8f95918f858d858f88838b87c88589c8938d) with group size, film, date and time and we’ll confirm if a discount is possible.

We also offer bespoke private hires — see details [here](#).

What is Baby Friendly?

Weekly screenings for parents/guardians with babies under 18 months. Only customers with babies will be admitted. Film volume is reduced and lights set to an intermediate level.

What is Kids’ Club?

For children aged 1–14 (eligible for child prices) plus their guardian(s). Max two adults per child. Adults without a child won’t be admitted.

What is Silver Screen?

Every Wednesday. Open to everyone with a special £8 rate for guests over 60.

What is Dog Friendly?

Occasional screenings (clearly signposted) where guests may bring one dog per adult.

What is your Dog Friendly screening policy?

We aim to ensure all customers enjoy their visit. If a dog adversely affects others, staff may ask the owner and dog to leave (per our Terms of Admission). Dog-friendly screenings are clearly advertised on our site and typically occur about every six weeks.

Dog-used seats are covered with blankets (laundered separately). The screen is fully cleaned after each event. Water bowls are provided; dogs should not be fed in the screen beyond small treats purchased at the cinema. A risk assessment is conducted for these screenings, and we may suspend them if necessary. In the unlikely event of fouling, our standard cleaning procedures apply and owners may be asked to assist.

What is Andrea’s Film Club?

Monthly intro and post-film discussion club hosted by BAFTA-winning filmmaker Andrea Carnevali. Classic films with behind-the-scenes insights and open discussion. All welcome.

What is the Film Quiz?

Hosted by Ashley Fisher in our Lounge bar. Max team size 6. £3 per person on the night. Prizes every quiz and a league top prize. Advance booking recommended.

What is the Jazz Night?

Complimentary live set from jazz duo *The Evening Standards* in the Lounge. All welcome.

What is Knitflicks?

Bring yarn and needles for a cosy social club with our friends at Yarn By The Water. Lights are only slightly dimmed. All welcome.

Learn more: [https://www.yarnbythewater.com/](https://www.yarnbythewater.com/)

What is French Impressions?

French film expert Jon Davies delivers an engaging pre-film lecture (about 60 minutes), followed by a short break and a hand-picked French release. All welcome.

What is Books on Film?

Hosted by The Unseen Review — a book club + screening exploring how literature is adapted for the big screen (hosted by Jessie Lethaby). All welcome.

What is Miyabi Social?

Handpicked Japanese films in partnership with the Miyabi Community, celebrating authentic Japanese culture through events and workshops. All welcome.

What is the Co-Working Day?

First Wednesday of the month with Chiswick Business Network. Informal networking in the Lounge bar, with complimentary 30-minute expert clinics. Bar open throughout. All welcome.

What are the Property Chats?

First Thursday of each month — informal meet-ups for property professionals in our Lounge bar. All welcome.

What is the Parent Collective Stay & Play?

Monthly stay-and-play in the Lounge for babies and toddlers with toys, games and friendly networking.

The Parent Collective — founded by two Chiswick sisters — builds a fun, inclusive community for parents with free meet-ups and support for local businesses.

What is the Chiswick Writing Group?

Lively discussions and feedback sessions in the Lounge bar — a great social to network while developing your writing. All welcome.

## Private Hire

Can I hire a cinema screen?

All spaces are available for hire. Please submit our enquiry form so we can plan your event and provide the right details: [chiswickcinema.co.uk/private-hire-enquiry](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/private-hire-enquiry/)

Can I hire other spaces in the cinema?

Yes — you don’t need to screen a film to hire the Lounge & Terrace. See menus and the form on our Private Hire page: [chiswickcinema.co.uk/private-hire](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/private-hire)

What are the film options for hiring the cinema?

Have a top-three film list ready and we’ll liaise with distributors to provide pricing options. We can also advise on suitable upcoming releases.

For larger events or your own screenings we’ll work with you on technical requirements.

How do I know what dates and times are available?

We offer screening slots to narrow options — please have two preferences to avoid disappointment. Contact us at least 30 days in advance so we can plan effectively; we’ll capture your preferences in the enquiry form.

Can I show my own film?

Yes — we’ll discuss whether it has BBFC certification and what formats are available before booking.

Can I sell my own tickets to a private hire?

No. Private hires are private events. Ticketed public screenings are part of the cinema’s programme only.

Do you offer catering?

Yes — via our Trafalgar Entertainment chef team. Please review options ahead of your enquiry.

How do I make an enquiry?

Submit the booking form with as much detail as possible and we’ll get back to you. [Enquiry form](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/private-hire-enquiry/)

## Advertising

Can I advertise in the cinema screens?

For weekly screenings and regular advertising, contact Pearl & Dean for rates and 4/13/26/52-week packages.

Contact: [[email protected]](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#90c0f1e5fcbedde5e2e0f8e9d0e0f5f1e2fcf1fef4f4f5f1febef3fffd) • +44 7876 381385

What sponsorship opportunities are there?

Sponsor a strand like Dog Friendly or special Q&A programmes (e.g., Chiswick in Film Festival) to reach a high-profile, engaged audience.

Our centre-piece cocktail & wine bar is also a dynamic sponsorship opportunity. Info pack available on request.

Can I advertise on the portrait screens in your foyer?

Yes — impactful vertical screens in the foyer and by the main bar box office reach high footfall year-round.

Contact: [[email protected]](https://www.chiswickcinema.co.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#5437263135203d223114363b3b393126353a333931303d357a373b7a213f)
